get.summary: Retrieve all social media profiles (channels) connected to the current Buffer user. Returns the channel IDs required to create posts.

200.description: [{id, service, service_username, avatar, timezone, paused, statistics: {followers, following}}]

get.description: Retrieve all social media profiles (channels) connected to the current Buffer user. Returns the channel IDs required to create posts.

post.summary: Queue a post to a Buffer channel, schedule it for a specific time, or publish it immediately. Set 'now' to publish right away, 'top' to insert at the front of the queue, or 'scheduled_at' to pick an exact send time. Without these options, the post is appended to the next available queue slot.

200.description: {success (bool), buffer_count (int), buffer_percentage (int), updates: [{id, created_at, day, due_at, due_time, media, profile_id, profile_service, status, text, text_formatted, user_id, via}]}

post.description: Queue a post to a Buffer channel, schedule it for a specific time, or publish it immediately. Set 'now' to publish right away, 'top' to insert at the front of the queue, or 'scheduled_at' to pick an exact send time. Without these options, the post is appended to the next available queue slot. Request body: Body: {profile_ids (required, array of strings — channel/profile IDs to post to), text (optional, string — post content), shorten (optional, boolean — auto-shorten links in text), now (optional, boolean — post immediately instead of queuing), top (optional, boolean — add to top of queue instead of bottom), media (optional, object — attachment with keys: link, description, title, picture, photo, thumbnail), attachment (optional, boolean — auto-populate media from links, default true), scheduled_at (optional, ISO 8601 datetime or Unix timestamp — schedule for a specific time, overrides top and now)}.

schema.description: Body: {profile_ids (required, array of strings — channel/profile IDs to post to), text (optional, string — post content), shorten (optional, boolean — auto-shorten links in text), now (optional, boolean — post immediately instead of queuing), top (optional, boolean — add to top of queue instead of bottom), media (optional, object — attachment with keys: link, description, title, picture, photo, thumbnail), attachment (optional, boolean — auto-populate media from links, default true), scheduled_at (optional, ISO 8601 datetime or Unix timestamp — schedule for a specific time, overrides top and now)}

id.description: Unique identifier for the post update.

text.description: The text content of the post.

due_at.description: Unix timestamp indicating when the post is scheduled to go out.

sent_at.description: Unix timestamp recording when the post was actually published.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp of when the post was created.

profile_id.description: Identifier of the channel this post is associated with.

Update.description: A Buffer post that is either queued or has been sent.

id.description: Unique identifier for the channel or profile.

avatar.description: URL of the profile's avatar image.

paused.description: Indicates whether the posting queue is currently paused.

service.description: The social network this profile belongs to: twitter, linkedin, facebook, instagram, pinterest.

timezone.description: Timezone configured for the channel (e.g., America/New_York).

service_username.description: Handle or username on the social network.

Profile.description: A social media account linked to Buffer.
